description:
The `make duplicate-check-verbose` report (2026-03-12) shows 363 duplicate groups /
9,326 duplicated lines (threshold 10,284). Wave-2 triage of the top-30 groups
identifies 12 groups that are intentional boilerplate, protocol conformance, or
TPC-DS spec-mandated query patterns. These should be suppressed via ignore_rules
to reduce noise and focus the checker on genuine consolidation targets.

Groups to mark as ignored (by report rank):

G2  (60 lines): supports_operation/is_setup/sql - protocol operation support
    methods across ai_primitives, metadata_primitives, transaction_primitives,
    write_primitives dataframe_operations modules and datafusion_df/pyspark_df.

G5  (60 lines): to_dict/get_etl_config/get_performance_config - dataclass-to-dict
    conversion methods on distinct config/artifact classes. Acceptable boilerplate.

G6  (60 lines): q62_expression_impl/q99_expression_impl - TPC-DS Q62 and Q99
    are spec-mandated structurally similar delivery-time bucketing queries
    against different channels (web vs catalog).

G14 (55 lines): compress_file/decompress_file/open_for_read - protocol stubs
    in context.py and protocols.py matching canonical impls in compression.py.

G17 (54 lines): window_dense_rank/window_rank/window_row_number -
    Protocol/ABC abstract method stubs in core/dataframe/context.py.

G19 (54 lines): q38_expression_impl/q87_expression_impl - TPC-DS spec pair
    using INTERSECT/EXCEPT patterns with 3-channel sales data.

G21 (52 lines): union_sales_channels_pandas/union_returns_channels_pandas -
    domain-specific channel union operations in tpcds channel_helper.py.

G22 (52 lines): __init__ on facade classes (datavault.py, tpcds.py, tpch.py) -
    API surface conformance constructors.

G25 (51 lines): create_sample_test_results/get_extended_table_order - AST
    false positive; different purposes but similar nested dict/list structure.

G26 (50 lines): cast_date/cast_string/col - partially covered by existing rule;
    extend path_contains to include tpcdi/tools/file_parsers.py and
    core/tuning/ddl_generator.py.

G27 (50 lines): get_stream_info/get_table_info/get_table_tuning - thin
    delegation methods on facade classes.

G29 (50 lines): _detect_format/col/get_row_count - extend existing rule to
    add get_row_count for platform adapters; partially already covered.

G30 (49 lines): q62_pandas_impl/q99_pandas_impl - pandas implementations
    of the same TPC-DS Q62/Q99 spec pair.
